[LIMP.4.1.1] After `import ha`, every top-level
declaration in `ha.ds` whose name does not begin with `_`
is reachable as `ha.<name>` in the importing file ([LGRA.2.10.4]).
This covers `schema`, `const`, and `rule` declarations
alike; the resolution rule is uniform across them. A
`service` is not reached through a library: services live in
one global namespace ([LGRA.10.1.6]).
